title: Prime Minister congratulates Sandeep Kumar on winning Gold and setting a new World Record at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Sandeep Kumar for an outstanding performance as a debutant, winning Gold in the Men’s 400m T64 event with a new World Record, which was made even more special as India’s 100th medal at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that his performance is a proud milestone for the nation, expressing hope that he continues to make India proud. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "A golden moment for Indian para athletics! Congratulations to Sandeep Kumar on winning Gold in the Men’s 400m T64 event with a new World Record. An outstanding performance by the debutant, made even more special as India’s 100th medal at the Asian Para Games. May he continue to make the nation proud: PM @narendramodi" A golden moment for Indian para athletics!
